review_method: Visual inspection of rendered PNGs; policy figure also inspected at original resolution.
checks: Titles, legends and axis labels readable; no clipping or overlap at original resolution.
Search x axis uses 1000 action candidates; evaluation x axis uses checkpoints 0/100/200.
Feasibility is plotted for max; LUT means for fully feasible int2float/i2c banks.
Shared uniform baseline is labelled; missing evidence is not drawn as zero.
